# Cedar Billing FAQ

Cedar invoices customers monthly for usage-based plans.

## Invoices

Invoices are emailed on the first business day of each month as PDF attachments.

## Refunds

### Eligibility

Refunds are available within 14 days of charge when usage is under 10 percent of the monthly allotment.

### How to Request

To request a refund, open a Cedar billing ticket and include the invoice number and charge date.
